title: Passage 30
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Headphones are helpful.
sentences.cn: 耳机很有用。

sentences.en: Many kids use them to listen to music or watch a cartoon.
sentences.cn: 许多孩子用它来听音乐或看动画片。

sentences.en: But headphones can be harmful too.
sentences.cn: 但耳机也可能有害。

sentences.en: They can cause hearing loss if the volume is too loud.
sentences.cn: 如果音量太大，可能会导致听力损伤。

sentences.en: Surveys show that one out of every ten kids in the US has some hearing loss.
sentences.cn: 调查显示，美国每十个孩子中就有一个存在一定程度的听力损伤。

sentences.en: The cause is loud noise, like listening to a band at a noisy concert.
sentences.cn: 原因是噪音太大，比如在嘈杂的音乐会上听乐队演奏。

sentences.en: Do you know how we hear?
sentences.cn: 你知道我们是如何听到声音的吗？

sentences.en: There are cells inside the ears that can't be seen with our eyes.
sentences.cn: 我们的耳朵里有眼睛看不到的细胞。

sentences.en: We call them hair cells, said Jackie Clark, a scientist studying noises and ears.
sentences.cn: 研究噪音和耳朵的科学家杰基·克拉克说：“我们称它们为毛细胞。”

sentences.en: Sound can make the hair cells move back and forward.
sentences.cn: 声音可以让毛细胞前后摆动。

sentences.en: Think of the wind in the leaves or a waving flag.
sentences.cn: 想象一下风吹树叶或飘动的旗帜。

sentences.en: Once the cells are damaged by loud noises, they don't grow back.
sentences.cn: 一旦毛细胞因噪音过大而受损，它们就不会再生。

sentences.en: Sometimes there's tinnitus.
sentences.cn: 有时还会出现耳鸣。

sentences.en: It's like someone is playing a note on the flute for a long time.
sentences.cn: 就像有人用笛子长时间持续吹奏同一个音一样。

sentences.en: It shows we're losing hearing and in the worst case, becoming deaf.
sentences.cn: 这表明我们的听力正在下降，最坏的情况下会变聋。

sentences.en: It makes us feel uneasy or even suffer an earache.
sentences.cn: 耳鸣会让我们感到不适，甚至遭受耳痛。

sentences.en: It's necessary to protect our ears so that we don't end up in hospital.
sentences.cn: 我们需要保护自己的耳朵，以免到头来不得不住院治疗。

sentences.en: Let's follow some strict rules to protect our ears.
sentences.cn: 让我们遵守一些严格的规则来保护我们的耳朵吧！

sentences.en: Keep the volume low, and seldom use headphones for more than one hour at a time unless it's necessary.
sentences.cn: 把音量调低，每次使用耳机不超过一小时，除非必要。

sentences.en: Don't use headphones in noisy places like a railway station,
sentences.cn: 不要在火车站等嘈杂的地方使用耳机，

sentences.en: because you will need to turn up the volume to hear clearly.
sentences.cn: 因为你需要调高音量才能听清楚。

sentences.en: If I can hear what you're listening to when you're wearing your headphones, Ms Clark said, It's too loud.
sentences.cn: 克拉克女士说：“如果你戴着耳机时，我能听到你在听什么，那就是太大声了。”

sentences.en: Although there are so many beautiful pieces of music, none should be listened to too loudly.
sentences.cn: 虽然世上有那么多美妙的音乐，但都不应该用太高的音量去听。
